# Research archive

<!-- Generated by skill `init-dsh-project` v1.8 on 2026-10-26. -->

This directory holds **research** — not decisions (those go to [`../adr/`](../adr/README.md)) and
not pending work (that goes to [`../issues/`](../issues/README.md)).

## Naming (the date is load-bearing)

| Shape | Purpose | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md` | **Point-in-time snapshot**: the facts and judgements as of one day. The date cannot be dropped — the doc expires, and the reader has to know which day it describes | `2026-09-21-upstream-api-contract.md` |
| `YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>/` directory | **A huge epic**: several reports, several weeks, criteria no existing gate can verify. It holds `README.md` (index) + `00-epic-sot.md` (single source of truth) + an `NN-<slug>.md` series. **Once the directory name exists it is never renamed** | `2026-09-21-model-epic/` |

## When it is mandatory

- A net-new subsystem · adopting or porting an external model / dataset / protocol / platform ·
  any choice that will become an ADR · a build-vs-reuse fork.
- **Not needed for**: bugfixes, mechanical refactors, work already covered by a research or ADR
  doc (cite that one).

## Discipline

1. **Research precedes implementation**: do not start writing implementation **before** the
   conclusion lands in this directory. This is where a cold agent learns "why the design looks
   like this" — research left in the chat history was never done.
2. **Provenance travels with the number**: every number / conclusion carries a source tag
   (`(measured)` / `(official)` / `(author-reported)` / `(unverified)`). A tag dropped while
   material is carried around is the most expensive kind of distortion in this project.
3. **State the verification boundary**: which machine / which dataset it was verified on, and
   what was not verified. What was not verified is a **stated** limitation, not a silent
   assumption.
4. **Disagreements do not go into the research docs**: when several research docs contradict each
   other, the orchestrator adjudicates in the SOT, not by editing the docs against each other.
5. **Expiry is not deletion**: the value of a snapshot is the judgement it held at the time. To
   update it, write a new one and add a line to the old one: "superseded by `<new file>`".
